external_entities.name: Supplier
external_entities.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.

external_entities.name: Category manager
external_entities.description: Category managers review supplier paperwork and approve or reject it.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: Vendor
external_entities.description: The vendor provides and hosts the SaaS portal and pushes supplier data extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The portal is a SaaS product. The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

processes.name: Supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload paperwork and category managers review it.

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: Loads the nightly supplier data extract and writes records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket in the organisation's cloud account receiving the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_stores.notes: The runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is.

data_stores.name: Supplier database
data_stores.description: The database into which the supplier master service writes extracted records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: Supplier uploads compliance paperwork and staff contact details to the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' staff.

data_flows.name: review paperwork
data_flows.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded supplier compliance paperwork and associated staff contact details.

data_flows.name: push extract
data_flows.description: Vendor pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: System description says, "We were told the nightly extract is encrypted end to end." The landing-bucket runbook says, "the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is." These claims do not establish a single encryption-in-transit value.

data_flows.name: load file
data_flows.description: Supplier master service loads the supplier data extract from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: Supplier master service writes extracted supplier records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.
data_flows.data_description: Supplier records from the nightly extract.

trust_boundaries.name: Vendor hosting
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor's hosting environment where the SaaS portal runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: Cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier document portal presents a web interface because it is described as a portal.
assumptions.basis: The source calls it a portal through which suppliers upload paperwork and category managers review it.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket contains confidential data because the extract contains supplier records and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The extract is described as supplier data, and the portal data includes contact details for suppliers' staff.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database contains confidential data because it stores supplier records derived from the extract.
assumptions.basis: The database stores records from the supplier data extract, which includes supplier and staff contact information.
